cohort: 340 women transferred to CHUK from district hospitals with post-delivery complications between June 2016 to July 2017
finding: Post-delivery complications and deaths are still high amongst women transferred from district hospitals, with the most common cause of post-vaginal complications being PPH and the most common cause of cesarean section complications being peritonitis.
mod_finding: The caesarean section (CS) complications were mainly due to peritonitis (63.8%) and PPH (30.3%).
